rationale: C23 plausibly supplied concrete language and machinery for section 2 of the child: extension of national-forest exterior boundaries, immediate addition and reservation of already-acquired lands, and automatic addition and reservation of qualifying lands upon future federal acquisition. This is a distinctive multi-part operative formula, not merely a shared subject. C01 is very close in language and date but lacks C23's especially strong future-acquisition mechanism. C09 parallels the child's combined exclusion/addition structure, but its monument-to-forest transfer machinery is less directly aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The exterior boundaries of the Apalachicola National Forest, the De Soto National Forest, and the Kisatchie National Forest ... are hereby extended to include the lands hereinafter described
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The exterior boundaries of the Chequamegon National Forest are hereby extended to include the following-described area
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same operative boundary-extension formula for a national forest followed by legal land descriptions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all of such lands that have been acquired by the United States under authority of Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, as amended, or the act of March 1, 1911, as amended, are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the designated national forests
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all lands within such area which have been acquired by the Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, as amended, or the said act of March 1, 1911, as amended, are herby added to land reserved as parts of the Chequamegon National Forest
shared_material.explanation: This is substantially the same dual-statutory acquisition and reservation mechanism, adapted from one forest to three.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all of such lands within the described areas that are hereafter acquired by the United States under the act of March 1, 1911, as amended, or any other law authorizing the acquisition of lands for national-forest purposes, shall likewise be added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests immediately upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all such lands hereafter acquired by the United States under such authority shall likewise be added to and reserved as parts of the said forest immediately upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C23's prospective, automatically effective reservation clause, including the distinctive phrase 'immediately upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States.'
